description: This file is the bootstrap script for the Notesnook web application, responsible for routing, initialization, and prerequisite checks.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Determines the current route based on the URL path, handling redirects for session expiry and registration.

methods.name: redirectToRegistration
methods.description: Redirects to the registration page if conditions are met.

methods.name: isSessionExpired
methods.description: Checks if the user session has expired and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: checkPrerequisites
methods.description: Verifies browser support for required APIs and secure context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes feature checks, prerequisites, and loads the appropriate route component.

methods.name: shouldSkipInitiation
methods.description: Determines if initiation steps should be skipped based on theme builder mode or local storage.
